grammar.summary: 本课学习被动语态（一般现在时/过去时）。

points.title: 被动语态 be + 过去分词
points.explanation: 执行者不重要时突出承受者：The instrument was made in 1681. 现在时被动：It is called a clavichord.（它被叫做古钢琴）。

examples.en: It was made in Germany in 1681.
The instrument is kept in the living room.

points.title: be + V-ed 进行时被动（现在完成被动初步）
points.explanation: has been + 过去分词：It has belonged to our family for a long time. 表状态延续。

examples.en: Recently it was damaged by visitors.
